name: ever-jobs
description: Multi-source job search tool. Searches 65+ job boards, ATS platforms, and company career pages (LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor, Greenhouse, Lever, Amazon, Apple, Microsoft, etc.) concurrently and returns normalized, structured job posting data via REST API, CLI, or MCP server.
author: Ever Co

job_search.description: Search for jobs across multiple job boards simultaneously
features: ATS board searching with company slug
Proxy rotation (HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS5; per-host stable by default, per-scrape, per-request or off)
Polite crawling by default: honest configurable User-Agent, per-host pacing, Retry-After-respecting back-off, optional robots.txt, egress guard (crawl policy, configurable per request via `crawl`)
Softy sitemap discovery with sequential detail fetches
Multi-location search in one request (sequential per source, same-source duplicates removed)
Title / keyword / preset exclusion filters (whole-word, negation-aware, never regex)
Analytics (summary stats, company intelligence, site comparison)
MCP server for AI assistant integration

siteType.description: Sites to search. Omit (and omit companyDomain) to search all search + company sources. Provide companySlug for ATS sources.

companyDomain.description: Company domains to resolve to Site tokens (e.g., 'buildcover.com', 'hyl.io'). Resolved tokens are unioned with siteType. Unresolved domains return HTTP 400.

companySlug.description: Company identifier for ATS scrapers (e.g., 'stripe', 'notion'). When set without siteType, only ATS scrapers run.

location.description: Location to search near (e.g., 'San Francisco, CA')

locations.description: Several locations searched in one request (e.g., ['New York, NY', 'Chicago, IL']). Each source runs once per location, one after another, with its own resultsWanted; same-source duplicates are removed. 'location', when also set, is searched first. The server searches the first EVER_JOBS_SEARCH_MAX_LOCATIONS (default 10) and reports the rest as bad_input diagnostics.

resultsWanted.description: Number of results per site (per site and location when 'locations' is set)

excludeTitleTerms.description: Drop jobs whose title contains any of these words or phrases (e.g., ['senior', 'lead*']). Whole-word, case- and accent-insensitive, trailing * = prefix, literal text (never a regex); negated mentions are ignored. Applied after dedup; the cache and stored corpus are unaffected.

excludeKeywords.description: Drop jobs whose title or description contains any of these words or phrases (e.g., ['security clearance', 'ts/sci']). Same matching rules as excludeTitleTerms.

excludePresets.description: Curated exclusion lists matched against title + description. security_clearance drops roles that require (or ask the candidate to obtain) a security clearance or vetting.

enforceAnnualSalary.description: Convert all wages to annual equivalent

rateDelayMin.description: Minimum delay between requests in seconds (maps to crawl.minIntervalMs, enforced per host bucket)

rateDelayMax.description: Maximum delay between requests in seconds (maps to crawl.jitterMs = (max - min) x 1000)

linkedinFetchDescription.description: Fetch full LinkedIn job descriptions (slower but more detailed)

linkedinCompanyIds.description: Filter LinkedIn results by company IDs

proxies.description: Proxy URLs for rotation. Which proxy a request uses follows crawl.proxyRotation (default: one stable proxy per host); the operator may refuse caller proxies (EVER_JOBS_CRAWL_CALLER_PROXIES=none).

userAgent.description: Custom User-Agent. Maps to crawl.userAgent and, unless crawl.userAgentMode is set, crawl.userAgentMode=strict so this UA is what goes out.

crawl.description: Per-request crawl policy (Spec 1690): identity, pacing, proxy rotation, retries, robots.txt, egress guard and discovery. Every field optional; the highest-precedence layer, subject to the operator setting EVER_JOBS_CRAWL_CALLER_OVERRIDES (any | stricter | none). The preset (EVER_JOBS_CRAWL_PRESET) is process-wide. Defaults below are the polite preset; plugins and operators may set others. See docs/CRAWL_POLICY.md.

userAgent.description: User-Agent to send. Keywords: default/everjobs (honest Ever Jobs UA), browser/legacy (pre-1690 Chrome/120 UA).

userAgentMode.description: Which UA goes on the wire: identify (default; our UA unless a plugin states why it needs its own), strict (our UA always), plugin (the plugin's declared UA).

from.description: Value of a From: request header (contact e-mail).

stripClientHints.description: Drop sec-ch-ua* headers when our UA is sent.

proxyRotation.description: per-host (default): one stable proxy per host bucket; per-scrape; per-request (round-robin, pre-1690); off.

rateLimitScope.description: Pacing bucket: host (default), domain (registrable domain), site.

maxConcurrentPerHost.description: Max requests in flight per bucket; 0 = unlimited.

minIntervalMs.description: Minimum gap between request starts in a bucket, ms.

maxQueueWaitMs.description: Longest wait for a slot before failing fast, ms; 0 = no limit.

adaptiveThrottle.description: Slow a bucket down after 429/503 and recover on success.

retries.description: Retries per request on a retryable status.

retryMaxDelayMs.description: Cap on one computed retry delay, ms.

respectRetryAfter.description: Never retry earlier than the server's Retry-After.

maxRetryAfterMs.description: A Retry-After longer than this triggers retryAfterOverMax, ms.

retryAfterOverMax.description: give-up (default): no retry, cool the whole host; cap: wait maxRetryAfterMs then retry (pre-1690).

throttleRetryDelayMs.description: Back-off floor after a 429/503, ms: retry n waits at least this x 2^n (capped at max(retryMaxDelayMs, this)) unless Retry-After asks for longer; also the minimum whole-host cool-down. 0 = no floor (pre-1690).

blockPrivateNetworks.description: Egress guard; a request may turn it on, never off.

discovery.description: Discovery strategy for plugins that have several (e.g. Softy); default auto.

examples.name: Exclude senior roles and roles that need a clearance
Polite crawl of a fragile ATS (per-request crawl policy)
